micro-RNA Heart Transplantation - Enrichment analysis

Setup & Libraries

library(dplyr)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(multiMiR)
library(miRBaseConverter)
library(enrichplot)
library(igraph)
library(ggraph)
library(patchwork)
library(ReactomePA)
library(clusterProfiler)

Enrichment analysis

MIMAT ID Conversion Converting mature miRNA names to MIMAT Accession IDs using miRBase to ensure accurate querying against target databases.

mirs <- miRNAVersionConvert(c("hsa-miR-125b-5p",
                              "hsa-miR-193b-5p", "hsa-miR-5588-5p"))$Accession
mirs
[1] "MIMAT0000423" "MIMAT0004767" "MIMAT0022295"

Validated Targets Retrieval Retrieving experimentally validated miRNA-target interactions strictly from the miRTarBase database using the multiMiR package, filtering out empty gene symbols.

mm_val <- get_multimir(
  org = "hsa",
  mirna = mirs,
  table = "validated"
)
Searching mirecords ...
Searching mirtarbase ...
Searching tarbase ...
df_val <- mm_val@data %>%
  dplyr::filter(database == "mirtarbase") %>%
  dplyr::select(mature_mirna_id, target_symbol) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  dplyr::filter(target_symbol != "")

unique(df_val$mature_mirna_id)
[1] "hsa-miR-125b-5p" "hsa-miR-193b-5p" "hsa-miR-5588-5p"

Gene ID Mapping Converting target gene SYMBOLs to ENTREZ IDs via clusterProfiler to prepare the data for downstream pathway enrichment analysis.

entrez_ids <- bitr(
  unique(df_val$target_symbol),
  fromType = "SYMBOL",
  toType = "ENTREZID",
  OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db
)

Merging Mapped IDs Joining the ENTREZ IDs back to the original target data frame.

df_mapped <- dplyr::inner_join(df_val, entrez_ids, by = c("target_symbol" = "SYMBOL"))
df_mapped

Target Gene Summary Calculating the total number of unique validated target genes for each candidate miRNA to evaluate their regulatory scope.

miRNA_summary <- df_mapped %>%
  dplyr::group_by(mature_mirna_id) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    unique_genes_count = dplyr::n_distinct(target_symbol),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(unique_genes_count)) 

print(miRNA_summary)
# A tibble: 3 × 2
  mature_mirna_id unique_genes_count
  <chr>                        <int>
1 hsa-miR-125b-5p                484
2 hsa-miR-193b-5p                216
3 hsa-miR-5588-5p                 50

Comparative Enrichment Analysis, Figure 3 Performing functional enrichment analysis across candidate miRNAs for Gene Ontology (Biological Processes) and Reactome Pathways to identify overrepresented biological functions.

# --- Gene Ontology (Biological processes) ---
go_compare <- compareCluster(
  ENTREZID ~ mature_mirna_id,
  data = df_mapped,
  fun = "enrichGO",
  OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
  ont = "BP",
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  readable = TRUE 
)
# --- Reactome Pathways ---
comp_reactome <- compareCluster(
  ENTREZID ~ mature_mirna_id, 
  data = df_mapped, 
  fun = "enrichPathway",
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05
)

Enrichment Visualization Generating and merging dot plots for GO and Reactome enrichment results, adjusting label length for readability, and exporting the combined figure to SVG format.

p_go <- dotplot(go_compare, showCategory = 20, label_format = 50) + # 40 символов на строку
  ggtitle("GO: Biological Process") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

p_reactome <- dotplot(comp_reactome, showCategory = 20, label_format = 50) + 
  ggtitle("Reactome Pathways") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

plt <- p_go | p_reactome
plt
ggsave("./pictures_transpl/Enrichment.svg", plot = plt, width = 13, height = 10, dpi = 300)
ggsave("./pictures_transpl/Enrichment.png", plot = plt, width = 13, height = 10, dpi = 300)

Network Visualization

Shared Target Filtering

df_shared <- df_val %>%
  dplyr::group_by(target_symbol) %>%
  dplyr::filter(dplyr::n_distinct(mature_mirna_id) >= 2) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()
df_shared

Hub Gene Summary

df_shared_summary <- df_shared %>%
  dplyr::group_by(target_symbol) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_interactions = dplyr::n_distinct(mature_mirna_id),
    miRNAs = paste(unique(mature_mirna_id), collapse = "; "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(n_interactions)) 

df_shared_summary

miRNA Interaction Frequency

gene_freq <- df_shared %>%
   dplyr::count(mature_mirna_id, name = "n_target") %>%
   dplyr::arrange(desc(n_target))

print(gene_freq)
# A tibble: 3 × 2
  mature_mirna_id n_target
  <chr>              <int>
1 hsa-miR-125b-5p       11
2 hsa-miR-193b-5p       10
3 hsa-miR-5588-5p        7

miRNA-mRNA Network Visualization, Figure 4

g <- graph_from_data_frame(df_shared, directed = FALSE)

V(g)$type <- ifelse(V(g)$name %in% unique(df_shared$mature_mirna_id), "miRNA", "Gene")

set.seed(123)
plt <- ggraph(g, layout = "stress") + 
  geom_edge_link0(color = "gray80", alpha = 0.7, width = 1) +
  geom_node_point(aes(color = type, size = type)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Gene" = "#4575b4", "miRNA" = "#d73027")) +
  scale_size_manual(values = c("Gene" = 4, "miRNA" = 10)) +
  geom_node_text(aes(label = name), repel = TRUE, size = 3.5, fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
  theme_graph() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14))
print(plt)
ggsave("./pictures_transpl/Network_plot.svg", plot = plt, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
ggsave("./pictures_transpl/Network_plot.png", plot = plt, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
